fact: Statistics Mauritius released online on 11 March 2025 Economic and Social Indicators Issue 1842, Population and Vital Statistics Year 2024, giving live births, deaths, infant deaths, still births and marriages registered in 2023 and 2024 (civil registration records; the year 2024 edition).
title: Economic and Social Indicators: Population and Vital Statistics, Year 2024 (Issue 1842)
